svg.aria-label: Detection pipeline: Cisco ISR 4331 and Catalyst 3850 syslog, OPNsense firewall and Suricata IDS alerts, Windows domain servers and the Proxmox and Docker hosts, and UniFi feed Wazuh, which decodes, correlates and responds, and forwards events to Splunk for search and dashboards. A brute force attempt against SWAGGER-DC-01 is correlated by Wazuh, which raises a level 10 alert and blocks the source.
svg.title: Detection pipeline
